recent_en: Scope Industries Berhad held its 24th AGM on 18 November 2026, with all resolutions approved by shareholders. Executive Chairman Lee Min Huat acquired shares in the open market in September. The latest financial results show a sharp year-on-year revenue decline and a quarter-on-quarter drop in net profit.
notable_en: The 24th AGM was held on 18 November 2026, with all resolutions passed by shareholders.
Executive Chairman Lee Min Huat acquired shares in the open market in September 2026.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Lee Min Huat indicated on 29 October 2026 an intention to deal during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM3,213,000, down 75.9% year-on-year but up 8.7% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM725,000, down 37.7% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin falling from 39.4% to 22.6%.
